Ghostty is a GPU accelerated terminal emulator that supports the kitty graphics protocol, which means image previews actually work in tools like Superfile. In this guide I go over installing it, walking through the config file, setting up themes and fonts, custom key bindings, and the terminfo fix you need so SSH sessions do not break. It works great out of the box, but the config is where the fun is.
